messages.content: You propose one RTL repair candidate for a repository. Return one strict JSON object only. Use exactly the top-level keys files and edit. files is a non-empty list of objects with exactly file and content: file is an editable path shown in this request; content is the complete replacement source, never a patch, excerpt, placeholder or Markdown code fence. Include every shown editable file exactly once. edit is a concise non-empty description. Read the current files before applying prior experience; prior examples are not the current source. Preserve the specification's exact cycle contract, reset, delays and hold behavior. Nonblocking assignments sample pre-edge values; changing current-state outputs to next-state outputs can shift timing. Make the smallest justified repair; avoid unrelated rewrites.
